newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says ASEAN may delay Cambodia's entry.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says ASEAN may delay Cambodia's entry.

text.p: Indonesian Foreign Minister Ali Alatas said on Wednesday that ASEAN had not ruled out the possibility of postponing Cambodia's entry into the seven-member grouping.

"If that is the desired consensus of ASEAN foreign ministers, then of course," he told reporters when asked whether the ASEAN foreign ministers' meeting scheduled for Thursday in Kuala Lumpur would postpone Cambodia's induction.
He said that among the aspects to be discussed on Thursday was who would represent Cambodia if the country was admitted into the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN).
"That is precisely one of the aspects we are going to discuss," he said, adding that representatives from Cambodia would not attend the Thursday meeting.

"We are going to discuss and review the situation and all its aspects and we are looking forward to hearing input from all the ASEAN members. This is not, of course, meant to interfere in the internal affairs of Cambodia because we in ASEAN uphold it (non-interference) strictly," he said.
ASEAN has called for an immediate ceasefire among warring factions in Cambodia, whose co-premiers are engaged in a bitter power struggle that has plunged the country into turmoil.
